{{Top|leg}}
The '''Duinarbulon Stones''' were a legendary set of [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that, if they existed, were thought to prove the existence of the [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]] who were considered to be a myth by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
